sentences.text:
ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BIREN VAISHNAV)
1.

We have heard Mr. Mahesh Bhavsar, learned advocate for the petitioners, Ms. Shruti Pathak,
learned Assistant Government Pleader for the State respondents and Mr.Maulik Nanavati learned advocate for the respondent no.4.
Learned advocates for the respondents waive service of notice of C/SCA/2703/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/03/2023 rule.
With the consent of the learned advocates for the parties, matter is taken up for final hearing today.

sentences.text:
In this petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner has prayed to direct the respondents to modify/revise the award dated 29.02.2013 bearing no.LAQ/N.H.-8/Case No.4(17) Lavarpur/2015 and award dated :
29/2/2016 bearing No.LAQ/N.H.-8/Case No.21, 78/(22),(54) Lavarpur/2016 by giving a further direction to recompute the compensation qua the lands to the petitioners by multiplying the market value as determined under Section 26(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 read with the First Schedule with Factor-2 as per Section 26(2) read with Schedule-I of the award and further direction

to grant all C/SCA/2703/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/03/2023 other statutory benefits including solatium under Section 13(1) and interest under Section 13(3) of the Act of 2013 with interest at the rate of 9% for the first year and 15% per annum for the next year.

4. Mr.Bhavsar would submit that the issue is covered by the decision of a coordinate Bench of this court rendered in the case of the Dhiraj Ambalal Patel vs. State of Gujarat [2020 (1) GLR 752].
5.

entities.text: Dhiraj Ambalal Patel vs. State of Gujarat [2020 (1) GLR 752]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Having heard learned advocates for the respective parties, since the issue is covered by the decision in case of Dhiraj Ambalal Patel (supra) and also considering the fact that in context of the lands of the same village, the Division Bench of this court by an order dated 14.10.2019 in a group of petitions being Special Civil Application No. 467 C/SCA/2703/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/03/2023 of 2019 and allied petitions and in light of the Division Bench in case of Dhiraj Ambalal Patel (supra)
directed the competent authority to recalculate the compensation by applying the suitable factor in light of the decision of the Division Bench.
6. Considering the awards in question and the survey numbers so stated in the awards for which recomputation is sought and in light of the statement made by Ms. Shruti Pathak, learned AGP that admittedly in case of the awards in question the multiplying factor-2 is applicable, the petition is allowed.

The respondents are directed to recalculate compensation and other statutory benefits as prayed for by applying the multiplying Factor - 2 in light of the decision in case of Dhiraj Ambalal Patel (supra) after verifying the details of each land.
The entire exercise shall be C/SCA/2703/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/03/2023 completed within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of the writ of the order of this court.

(A.J.DESAI, ACJ) (BIREN VAISHNAV, J) ANKIT SHAH Anandiben W/O Ramanbhai Somabhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182379917/
